author: Erik Lundby
releaseNotes: Adds a Simple Home helper to create and wire a House Intent virtual room as the house reference.

apps.name: Simple Home
apps.description: Parent app for lightweight room state, mode, and lighting child apps.

apps.name: Simple Room State
apps.description: Room state child app that manages occupancy, courtesy, lock, sleep, and room meta-device output.

apps.name: Simple Mode Manager v2
apps.description: Simple mode manager for home, away, vacation, day, evening, and night transitions.

apps.name: Simple Room Lighting v2
apps.description: Room-centric lighting adapter for MetaLight output, physical lights, scenes, remotes, and mode or intent matrices.

apps.name: Simple Circadian Lighting v2
apps.description: Publishes a circadian reference level and color temperature from an outdoor light sensor.

drivers.name: Simple Room Meta Device
drivers.description: Public room device exposing switch, level, lock, room state, lighting intent, and component child controls.

drivers.name: Simple Room Meta Light Device
drivers.description: Automation-facing effective room light component device.

drivers.name: Simple Room Child Switch Device
drivers.description: Reusable component switch for Simple Room controls such as Courtesy, Engaged, Asleep, Locked, and recovery.

drivers.name: Simple Open-Meteo Outdoor Light Device
drivers.description: Outdoor light context driver that publishes lux, color temperature, cloud cover, and sky condition from Open-Meteo.
